rationale: A dimensionally COHERENT family around a single 5.0 mm pin, ordered by feature count so a score can show WHERE accuracy falls off rather than collapsing to one average. Every bore is 2.6 mm radius against the 2.5 mm pin: 0.1 mm radial = 0.2 mm diametral clearance, the low edge of the repo's 0.20-0.40 mm PLA slip-fit band, and the same bore_r the archived bench-004 hinge reference used. Authored BEFORE and INDEPENDENTLY of any generation, which is what makes it an acceptance criterion rather than a description of whatever the engine happened to build.

nodes.note: One cylinder. The floor: any engine that misses this is broken.
Hollow cylinder; running fit on the pin. Tests that a bore is subtracted, not painted.
Plate with two end bores at a set margin -- the commonest real part shape.
Two knuckles plus a clearance notch that must interleave with its mirror leaf. The first tier where feature POSITION matters as much as size.
A raised hub with a bore plus an arm with a far hole -- two features at different Z, the case where a flat-plate approximation scores well on IoU and is still wrong.
